sentiment.rationale: This pre-earnings digest describes depressed expectations: analyst estimates have been cut 21.4% over 90 days, the stock fell sharply after Q4, and Q1 guidance was set well below prior estimates, lowering the bar for a positive surprise. Emerging positive narratives around AI shopping and tvScientific provide potential upside drivers, but macro headwinds and margin concerns temper the outlook. Overall, the low bar and potential catalysts suggest a mildly bullish setup for the stock heading into the print.
